name: folk
summary: AI CRM for small sales teams with enrichment, sequences and LinkedIn, Gmail and WhatsApp sync.
description: folk is a CRM for small teams that imports contacts from LinkedIn, Gmail, Outlook and WhatsApp, enriches them and runs messages and sequences, pipelines and call recording, with AI sales assistants, an API and an MCP server. Standard costs $24 per member per month billed yearly and Premium $48; a free trial is offered, and a permanent free plan was not confirmed.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The official pricing page lists Standard at $24 per member per month billed yearly and Premium at $48, with Enterprise from $80. Sign-up starts a two-week trial, and the FAQ says a subscription can be cancelled by downgrading to the free plan.

howToUse.title: Open folk
howToUse.description: Go to folk and choose Login or Get a demo. It is a CRM for small teams.

howToUse.title: Import and enrich contacts
howToUse.description: folk imports contacts from LinkedIn, Gmail, Outlook, and WhatsApp, then enriches them.

howToUse.title: Run messages, pipelines, and recording
howToUse.description: Run messages and sequences, pipelines, and call recording with the AI sales assistants.

howToUse.title: Connect the server and compare prices
howToUse.description: Use the API and the MCP server. Standard costs $24 per member per month billed yearly, and Premium costs $48. A trial is offered, and a permanent free plan was not confirmed.

features: AI CRM for small sales teams with enrichment, sequences and LinkedIn, Gmail and WhatsApp sync.

folk is a CRM for small teams that imports contacts from LinkedIn, Gmail, Outlook and WhatsApp, enriches them and runs messages and sequences, pipelines and call recording, with AI sales assistants, an API and an MCP server.
Standard costs $24 per member per month billed yearly and Premium $48; a free trial is offered, and a permanent free plan was not confirmed.
features_fr: AI CRM pour petites équipes commerciales avec enrichissement, séquences et synchronisation LinkedIn, Gmail et WhatsApp.

folk est un CRM pour petites équipes qui importe des contacts depuis LinkedIn, Gmail, Outlook et WhatsApp, les enrichit et exécute des messages et des séquences, des pipelines et des enregistrements d'appels, avec des assistants commerciaux IA, une API et un serveur MCP.
Standard coûte 24 $ par membre et par mois, facturé annuellement et Premium 48 $ ; un essai gratuit est proposé et un forfait gratuit permanent n’a pas été confirmé.
